brief.headline: Massive Russian strike on Kyiv; Ukraine hits Kstovo refinery
brief.lead: Channels celebrated a large combined missile-and-drone barrage on Kyiv and Ukrainian defense plants while grimly reporting a 460-drone Ukrainian counter-strike hitting the Kstovo refinery and a border bus. Tone was buoyant on strikes and frontline gains but defensive over losses at home.

developments.title: Channels tout massive combined strike on Kyiv
developments.body: Channels claimed Russia launched 74 missiles and 496 drones (some cite 60+ missiles) against Kyiv, Kharkiv and Dnipro, hitting named defense plants Radioniks, Atlon Avia and Antonov, plus logistics hub Chayka. Peskov reportedly said Putin was briefed on the 'retaliatory' strike. Damage claims are channel/MoD-sourced and unconfirmed.

developments.title: Ukrainian 460-drone strike hits Kstovo refinery, regions
developments.body: Channels reported Ukraine launched some 460 drones (327 allegedly downed) across Russian regions overnight, striking the Kstovo oil refinery in Nizhny Novgorod and Zaporizhzhia NPP's fire station. Uniformly negative framing; figures are channel-sourced.

developments.title: Frontline advances claimed at Piskunovka, Konstantinovka, Kupyansk
developments.body: Multiple channels claimed capture of Piskunovka along the Seversky Donets toward the Slavyansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration, continued systematic advance through Konstantinovka after a year-long battle, and gains near Kuchyrovka on the Kupyansk axis. Unconfirmed battlefield claims.

developments.title: Fuel-infrastructure campaign framed as causing shortages
developments.body: Channels emphasized a sustained campaign against Ukrainian fuel stations and oil bases, claiming 70 stations destroyed and supply shortages in Sumy, Kharkiv and Dnipropetrovsk. Framing stresses military-logistics rationale; impact claims unconfirmed.

developments.title: Focus on NATO Ankara summit and Western rearmament
developments.body: Rybar and others previewed the July 7-8 NATO summit in Ankara, citing tens of billions in defense contracts and a 5% GDP target, plus claims Ukraine sought €6.6bn from the EU Peace Fund and Britain testing 1,200km 'Brakestop' missiles. Presented as escalation toward NATO-Russia war.

developments.title: Border bus attack amplified as Ukrainian provocation
developments.body: Channels heavily amplified a claimed Ukrainian drone strike on the Minsk-Anapa passenger bus at the Russian-Belarusian border, injuring two drivers, alongside a paint/mock-bomb incident at Russia's Stockholm embassy — framed as civilian-targeting provocations.

narrative_watch.title: Strikes framed as 'retaliatory' and precise
narrative_watch.body: The Kyiv barrage is cast as a legitimate 'retaliatory' strike on military-industrial targets, invoking Putin's briefing and Zelensky 'legitimacy' talking points to justify deep strikes.

narrative_watch.title: NATO summit as prelude to direct war
narrative_watch.body: Coverage of Ankara summit, Lithuanian WMD proposals and British missiles builds a frame that the West is arming Ukraine to prolong war before an eventual NATO-Russia confrontation.

narrative_watch.title: Self-criticism over refinery vulnerability
narrative_watch.body: Sladkov and NgP raZVedka question whether leadership is learning lessons after the Kapotnya refinery damage and predictable strike cycles — rare introspective dissent.

mood_lines.text: Uniformly triumphant (net +100) over the large Kyiv barrage and claimed hits on named defense plants and fuel infrastructure.
Positive across the board, boosted by claimed captures at Piskunovka, Konstantinovka and Kupyansk advances.
Sharply negative (net -100, down 79) after the 460-drone barrage, Kstovo refinery hit and the border bus attack.
Deeply negative, worsening on Ankara summit rearmament, EU funding and British missile deliveries.
Buoyant (net +71, up sharply) via drone-operator profiles, Akhmat units and a treason arrest framed as security wins.
Fully negative; scattered digs at leadership over refinery lessons and mockery of Ukrainian air-defense claims.

flag_texts.title: Ukraine strikes on Russia plunges to -100
flag_texts.body: Sentiment on domestic strikes dropped 79 points to net -100 as channels reacted to a claimed 460-drone Ukrainian barrage, the Kstovo refinery hit and the Minsk-Anapa border bus attack.

flag_texts.title: West & NATO sentiment falls 31 points
flag_texts.body: Coverage soured further (net -93) around the July 7-8 Ankara summit, the €6.6bn EU Peace Fund request, British long-range missiles and Lithuania's WMD-deployment proposal.

flag_texts.title: Russia internal sentiment jumps +131
flag_texts.body: Domestic mood swung positive (net +71) on morale content — FPV/Akhmat drone-operator profiles, a treason arrest tied to arson, and Rybar's upbeat daily digest.

flag_texts.title: Mobilisation and Putin criticism stay quiet
flag_texts.body: Watchlist items 'Mobilisation rumours' and 'Criticism of Putin' saw no substantive activity; the day's criticism targeted general leadership over refinery defenses, not Putin directly.
